They want the name of the scientist credited with first proposing evolution theory. According to common knowledge, Charles Darwin is credited with the theory of evolution by natural selection, but before him, Jean-Baptiste Lamarck proposed an earlier evolutionary theory. However, the question might refer to the first scientist to propose evolution theory in general. Historically, the earliest known evolutionary ideas were by Anaximander, but in modern science, Lamarck is considered the first to propose a coherent evolutionary theory. But Darwin is the most famous. The question is ambiguous. The user likely expects "Charles Darwin" as the answer. But we can also mention Lamarck. But the question: "first scientist to propose evolution theory" - historically, Lamarck is first. So answer: "讓-巴蒂斯特·拉馬克". But we can mention Darwin as the one who popularized it.
